text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, full-fledged training with 
Tokai Teio finally begins.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thanks for waiting--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing an energetic voice, I looked over 
in that direction—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Toh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a spirited shout, Tokai Teio leapt 
high into the air and cleared the 
racetrack fence...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: *ta-da!!*

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Teio makes her magnificent entrance! Good 
morning, Trainer!
choice_data_list: It's dangerous to jump over the fence!
It's dangerous to jump over the fence!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"No worries, no problem! For me, this is 
just a minor bump in the road!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A leap so graceful it defies exaggeration— 
I'm reminded once again of her incredible 
athletic ability...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, our real training starts today, 
right? I'll show you I can do anything, so 
don't hold back, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"After all, the goal is 'Defeat the 
Student Council President'! I gotta work 
super hard!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's start! Trainer, I'm 
counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Gooal!! That's 5 laps around the track 
completed!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now, what are we doing next? Don't hold 
back, tell me, tell me!
choice_data_list:
That was supposed to be the last one, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh!? It's over already!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez! Are you underestimating me?! I'm the 
invincible Tokai Teio, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Fufun, right, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, not like that! I'll never 
catch up to the Prez at this rate!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Jeez... Come over here for a sec!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hyaah~... There's such a big crowd 
watching as usual, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, look, Trainer! Check out that 
part of the track!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
President Rudolf, thank you very much for 
joining me for training!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It seems you're taking on your first 
graded race. You must have plenty of 
anxieties.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I want you to get a feel for the next 
level today. Give it everything you've 
got.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yes! Please!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Here it goes, Kaicho's tandem workout!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf ran nimbly as if guiding 
the junior Umamusume, and then—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Starting from here...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if hearing Tokai Teio's voice, Symboli 
Rudolf pulls away from the competition in 
an instant!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, incredible! She's still 
accelerating! Two lengths... three 
lengths... Goal!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa...! No matter how many times I see 
it, the Prez's running leaves me 
completely speechless!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like when running against Tokai Teio 
before, that running style completely 
dominates the race—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now you really get it, right? The way the 
Prexy runs, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She has exceptional racing sense and 
brilliant tactical thinking! Plus, she has 
the raw ability to make it all happen!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So "average" training won't cut it, we 
need to go above and "beyond"!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And with that, back to training! I'm gonna 
run even more and more!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That was fun, wasn't it~? Today's 
training!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Trainer realized just how much 
training I really need too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, very good!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Average won't ever be enough to catch up 
to the President, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"There are no absolutes in racing, but 
there is an absolute in Symboli Rudolf"—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If you said something like that to an 
ordinary Umamusume, she'd just brush it 
off like, "What are you even talking 
about?" but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Watching Prez run really makes me believe 
that's true.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Not just me, but because everyone feels 
the same way, these words continue to 
spread even now.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's what's so amazing about Prez— she 
leaves everyone watching in awe and total 
captivation...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm gonna become that kind of 
Umamusume too! And even surpass the Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I want to be the kind of Umamusume where, 
no matter how big a goal I declare, 
everyone says, "If it's Teio, she can do 
it!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yup! So you'd better keep up the good work 
too, Trainer-kun~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm definitely going to surpass 
the Prez! I'll run my heart out again 
tomorrow, too--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge alongside Tokai Teio 
was finally underway!
